tasks.subject: Commit baseline upstream code
tasks.description: Commit the existing upstream score-flyio code as the starting baseline on main. No changes.

tasks.subject: Add internal/progresify typed metadata contract
tasks.description: New package internal/progresify: typed metadata.progresify contract (owner, slackChannel, secretNamespace, region, ingress, releaseCommand, variables, processes) with parsing from workload metadata map + validation. Validation rules: every declared process has exactly one matching Score container name; no container left unconfigured; process config has vm, scale, machineGroup, httpService, concurrency, checks, restart; ingress restricted to private (internal) or cloudflare (public staging); container names valid pattern, no dupes/empty. P0 Angada topology contract items.

tasks.subject: Add internal/machineconfig multi-container model
tasks.description: New package internal/machineconfig: typed multi-container machine group model — containers[] with per-container image/command/args/env/files/mounts/restart, machine guest resources, services, checks, region, lifecycle policy (restart/schedule/autodestroy/stop_config). Container name preservation + reject duplicate/empty/invalid names. Colocation semantics validation: containers in one machine share scale and lifecycle. Deterministic conversion helper to flymachines.FlyMachineConfig. Replaces single-container guard model in internal/convert.

tasks.subject: Multi-container conversion in internal/convert
tasks.description: internal/convert: replace single-container guard with typed multi-container flow. Deterministic mapping from Score containers + metadata.progresify.processes to machine groups. Different images in one machine allowed (cloudflared). Keep legacy fly.toml AppConfig output path working for single-container workloads without progresify metadata. Unit tests for field mapping and invalid combos.

tasks.subject: Add Machines API deployer primitives
tasks.description: New package internal/deployer: Machines API deployer over internal/flymachines generated client — create, inspect, update, wait (state + health-check readiness), stop, suspend, restart, delete, list machines. Never report success on API response alone; wait for started state + checks passing. Mocked contract tests using httptest server.

tasks.subject: Idempotent reconciliation + rollback
tasks.description: internal/deployer: reconciliation — compare desired machine groups vs live machines (by metadata), update in place when config equal (no replacement), create missing, remove orphans only when expected count known; partial-failure recovery: stop/suspend or roll back machines created during failed apply. Idempotency tests: second identical apply is a no-op.

tasks.subject: CLI: plan/apply commands + generate --deploy machines path
tasks.description: internal/command: add plan and apply commands with --dry-run and machine-readable JSON plan output (renderer version, workload, environment, machine group, image). generate --deploy uses Machines API deployer when workload needs multi-container support; never silently falls back to invalid TOML plan. Tests via executeAndResetCommand.

tasks.subject: Full suite + lint + tick TODOS
tasks.description: Run go build, go vet, full go test ./..., golangci-lint if available. Tick completed TODOS.md checkboxes. Final review of diff. Commit.
